results.name: no camera clears the whole reading, date included
a focus reading, then camera moves throttled to one render per 100 ms
a flight blanks the reading but keeps the date, holds still, and arrival refreshes once
a flight that begins while a throttled render waits on its timer
a hidden page drops pending work and a visible one refreshes
playback keeps rendering, and stopping it does not
the scene element leaving clears the reading; resize refreshes
destroy with a frame pending, then with a timer pending
a flight that begins while a frame is pending, then arrives
setters after destroy and while hidden schedule nothing
switching cameras unsubscribes the old one

limits: Equivalence holds for these scenarios only. A match proves the traces the scenarios record are equal, not that every behaviour is.
Files other than the targets come from the working tree on both sides; otherChangedFiles lists any that also differ.
Coverage is V8 block coverage mapped through the bundle source map; a line counts as run when any of its generated code ran.
